title: Crosswind landing
summary: Buffalo's runway 05 with eighteen knots across it, gusting: crab down the approach, kick it straight, land on the centreline.
briefing: Five miles from Buffalo's runway zero five, and the wind is from one four zero at eighteen, gusting twenty-six: almost straight across from the right.
Fly the approach crabbed into the wind, nose pointing a little right of the runway. Just before touchdown, rudder the nose straight with the centreline, keep the wings level, and put her down.

tasks.goal: Land on the centreline in the crosswind.
tasks.say: Keep the localizer centred with the crab. Add a few knots for the gusts. At fifteen feet, rudder straight.
tasks.done: On the ground. Keep the wings level into the wind as you slow.

cues.say: Drifting right of the centreline: more crab into the wind.
We're left of the centreline: ease the crab.
Wings level near the ground: the engines hang low.

debrief.three: Crabbed, kicked straight and planted on the centreline. That's a crosswind landing.
debrief.two: A good crosswind landing. A little earlier with the rudder before the wheels touch.
debrief.one: Down safely in a tough wind. Fly the crab all the way to the flare, then straighten.
debrief.failed: The crosswind won that one. Crab into it, and straighten just before touchdown. Again?
